launch.settings.presetsHelp: Right-click a tab to open a new tab in its folder with one of these AI tools and models.
launch.settings.openersHelp: Apps shown in the tab right-click menu. Use the app name (for example Visual Studio Code) or its full path.
launch.settings.name: Name
launch.settings.modelsHelp: Models offered in the tab editor and presets. Separate names with commas. Leave empty to use the built-in list (shown as the placeholder); to update, edit here.
